preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the string N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must contain only lowercase English letters.
The total length of all strings S across test cases must not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not is_palindrome_possible(S) else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to make the string S a palindrome, the output must be 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and isinstance(min_operations, int) and min_operations >= 0
postconditions.description: If it is possible to make the string S a palindrome, the output must be 'YES' followed by the minimum number of operations.

postconditions.expression: min_operations == 0 if S == S[::-1] else True
postconditions.description: If the string S is already a palindrome, the minimum number of operations must be 0.
